_readme: Hand-authored weekly grid for the NBC station in /otr Station mode (station.js). Same rules as abc.grid.json:
listener's local clock, composite week (each slot is a real NBC day and time from one season, neighbours may differ),
conf: verified = printed in a season ratings table (Jim Ramsburg, GOld Time Radio); likely = standard reference knowledge;
approx = day confirmed by the catalog's episode dates, hour placed by judgment; fill = a labelled stand-in.
NBC here means the NBC Red Network before 1943 and NBC after. Blue Network slots belong to the ABC grid.
name: NBC
tagline: What NBC was carrying at this hour, this day of the week, 1936-53
blurb: A composite week of the National Broadcasting Company, the network of the big Sunday and Tuesday night comedy blocks: Jack Benny at 7 on Sunday, then Phil Harris and Alice Faye, Charlie McCarthy and Fred Allen; Tuesday with Amos 'n' Andy, Fibber McGee, Bob Hope and Red Skelton; Groucho and Mr. District Attorney on Wednesday; Dragnet on Thursday; Truth or Consequences and the Grand Ole Opry on Saturday. Episodes run back to back with no commercials, so a half hour slot often fits two. Your local clock, like an affiliate.

slots.src: Ma Perkins, NBC weekdays 3:15 PM, 1942-49 (NYT log 8 and 11 Nov 1948: WNBC 3:15; Chicago Tribune 8 Nov 1948: WMAQ 2:15 CT; Oxydol); also on CBS at 1:15
Vic and Sade, NBC weekday quarter hour 1932-44 (episode dates confirm Mon-Fri); afternoon slot placed
Jack Armstrong, NBC weekdays 5:30 PM, 1936-41 (Wheaties), before the move to Blue/ABC
Tom Mix Ralston Straight Shooters, NBC weekdays 5:45 PM, 1933-42, before the Mutual years

slots.label: Lowell Thomas and the News (fill)
slots.src: Lowell Thomas held NBC 6:45 PM weeknights for Sun Oil until 1947 (ratings tables 1943-47: M-F 6:45 15 NBC), then CBS; no usable recordings, strips fill

slots.label: Supper Club (fill)
slots.src: The Chesterfield Supper Club held NBC 7:00 weeknights 1944-49 (NYT logs 9, 10 and 12 Nov 1948: WNBC 7:00 'Supper Club Variety'); not on archive.org, strips and sports fill

slots.label: News of the World (fill)
slots.src: News of the World held NBC 7:15 weeknights in 1948 and 7:30 from 1950 (NYT logs Nov 1948, Nov 1950, 3 Nov 1952: WNBC 'News of the World, Morgan Beatty'); no recordings, strips fill

slots.label: One Man's Family quarter hour (fill)
slots.src: One Man's Family held NBC 7:45 weeknights 1950-55 (NYT logs 6-10 Nov 1950 and 3 Nov 1952: WNBC 7:45); the catalog has only its earlier half-hour shows, which play on Sunday afternoon instead
The Railroad Hour, NBC Monday 8:00 PM, 1949-54 (ratings tables: Mon 8:00 30 NBC; NYT logs 6 Nov 1950 and 3 Nov 1952: WNBC 8:00). Cavalcade of America held Monday 8:00 in 1948
